utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re mostly set, but I’ll keep an ear out for any extra tools while I’m running errands and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—if you hear we still need something, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll let you know right away if I spot anything we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center should work. I’ve got the basics covered, so Rosa can handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — let’s keep the community center as the starting point. If anything shifts, let me know and I’ll make the rest clear as we go.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli — I will.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s start at the community center after lunch, and I can bring the tools if you tell me which ones you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still missing the exact time, though—can you confirm it so we don’t leave anyone guessing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies and make a quick list of what’s still missing for the repair drive. Tape, gloves, and spare screws would be especially helpful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll mention the usual spot by the community center and the afternoon start time. I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver set, and thanks for checking the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—I’ll sort through what we’ve got and bring a list of anything still missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Dane. I’ll start at the community center and keep track of the gaps as we go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll swing by after lunch and bring anything I can find. Let me know if there’s still a big gap in the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep an eye on the list and let you know what’s still missing. If there’s a big gap, your extra supplies will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After school still works for me. Send me the volunteer list and supply details, and I’ll take care of what I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll send the volunteer list and supply needs over, and you can take whichever pieces fit your after-school window.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll look for your list and pick up the pieces that fit after school.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center should work well. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at 10 a.m. at the community center sounds good to me. I’m still getting the supplies together, so I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. Let me know if you still need anything else from me for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — the next stop is the community center, and pickup is at 9:00 AM. I’ll keep the route clear and send the final list right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the next stop is the community center and pickup is at 9:00 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that’s right — community center, 9:00 AM pickup. I’ll send the final route list now so everything stays clear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — community center first. I still don’t have the start time, so I’ll wait for that before I add anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I only have the community center noted so far, and I don’t have the start time yet either.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve only got the community center down for now, and I’ll wait for the start time before adding the next stop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just tell folks it’s by the community center in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll tell folks the repair drive starts by the community center in the afternoon. I’m still sorting the last bits, but I’ll keep the hammer and screwdriver set ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — that’s the spot and time. I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center, right? I can spread the word about that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’s the one — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center. I’ll pass along any new repair-drive updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and spread the word about Saturday at 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still only have the community center as the first stop, so I’m missing the time and the rest of the route. If you’ve got more details, I can help piece them together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s all I’ve got for now too — the community center is the first stop, and I’m still tracking the time and the rest of the route. I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep the community center as the first stop and wait for the time and route details. If you hear anything else, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Eli — starting at the community center makes sense. Tell me what you need next, and I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Let’s keep it simple: check who’s bringing tools, then let me know if anything is missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll check who’s bringing tools and let you know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center — I’m just sorting the volunteer list and supplies right now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Once you have the exact time and the community center address, please send them over so I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the exact time and address as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and point people to the community center for Saturday at 10 a.m. Just send me the rest when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep pointing folks to the community center at 10 a.m. on Saturday, and I’m happy to pass along the rest as soon as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just say the usual spot by the community center this afternoon. I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m in for after lunch at the community center. If you still need anything else, I can help round it up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — after lunch at the community center is the usual spot. Thanks, Dane; I’ll shout if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We still need the volunteer list organized and the supplies sorted for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can organize the volunteer list and help sort the supplies for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Sam — that covers the big pieces for Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep everyone posted and make sure we’re all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s note the community center first, and I’ll keep track of the rest as you tell me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center works for me. I’m happy to help with anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve got Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community center noted. Tell me the next stop whenever you’re ready, and I’ll keep tracking the route.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking what’s left, but I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver set if we need them. Thanks for helping gather anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we still need nails, tape, or any extra gloves?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll check what we have and let you know if we still need nails, tape, or extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli. I’ll send anyone who needs tools your way — anything else still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I think we’re set for now — Rosa said she’ll take the rest from here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks — I’ll let people know we’re set for now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s on Sunday at the community center now. I’m still ironing out the start time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve got the community center and Sunday. Please let me know the start time as soon as it’s set, and I’ll check what tools I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll share the start time as soon as it’s confirmed. Thanks for checking on the tools, too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep you posted as soon as Eli lays out the rest, and I’ll fit it in after school if I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye — just let me know the time and place when you hear it, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’m waiting on Eli to confirm the time and place, then I’ll send you the details after school.
